## Space Shooter
### Description: Simple Space Shooter, having power up, wave of enemy, a final boss
### Open and run the project in Unity 2022.3.62f2. Switch flatform to Android.
### Using WASD to control. Avoid enemies' bullets.
### Known issues/incomplete features: 
#### - No Multiple levels or a progression system. Just simple gameplay.
#### - No clear boss state.
### AI Usage:
#### - AI tools: Gemini chat bot
#### - The MultiBulletPoolManager.cs is generated by Gemini but modified to be Singleton. Other classes using Object pool pattern is copied from this class
#### - In EnenmyManager.cs the logic of spawing enemy in pattern is generated by Gemini. Also modified to keep track of active enemy.
#### - In EnemyController.cs the logic of moving following waypoint is generated by Gemini. Modified so it not move out of view.
#### - Parts were written entirely by you without AI assistance: player related class, GameManager, HUDController, UI scripts.
#### - How AI help me: 
#### + Cut down development time by bypassing traditional search for document.
#### + Accelerated architecture design, providing instant boilerplate code for multi-pooling and waypoint mechanics.
